pages.text: The $(d)Igniter$() can be used to light a fire in front of itself, when given a redstone signal.$(br2)It has 3 modes, set in its GUI:$(br)$(li)Toggle: Lights when powered, extinguishes when unpowered$(br)$(li)Keep Ignited: Keeps the fire lit while powered, does nothing when unpowered$(br)$(li)Ignite: Lights when powered, does nothing when unpowered
